changes.title: Aggro fade out
items: When wild animals stop sizing you up (they attack, you invite one, or you leave), their red now fades away instead of switching off

changes.title: Wave strings
items: A wave arriving no longer stutters while its string lights go up: the forest they hang in is grown ahead

changes.title: Relic sigil size
items: A relic you carry now shows as its full flask sigil beside your stack, as big as an animal's, instead of a tiny glint
